**Ready for the maintainer to merge**, with the safety notes below for the maintainer's eye (high-tier review: this changes posted G-code). Thank you, this is careful and well-documented work.

**What looks good**
- Clean-room provenance is explicit: the post header and `docs/decisions/51-heidenhain-cycles.md` cite HEIDENHAIN's public TNC 640 Cycle Programming manual (892905-25) by section and page, with a stated "no vendor post consulted". No Fusion/HSMWorks material found in the diff.
- Q parameters read correctly against the cycle definitions as documented: `Q203` is the absolute surface in the shifted frame (`EntryZ - orgZ`), `Q200`/`Q204` are non-negative incremental clearances (`R - EntryZ`, so the cycle returns to R), `Q201` is the signed incremental depth (negative), and `Q395=0` keeps the tool-tip reference. Origin shifts are applied only to the absolute M99 positioning block and Q203, not to the increments. Depth sign, clearance sign and range are checked in `heidenhain.cps` before any word is written (`cycleBad` refusals).
- Existing `tap`/`TAP` stays rigid (G207). Floating is a separate appended `FloatingTap`/`floating_tap` choice, so older files load unchanged. `tapping_mode.rs` pins legacy defaults, the undoable edit, undo/redo, and the save/load round-trip. It goes through `EditOperationParams`, and MCP/scripting ride the same `ParamsDto`.
- Refusals are by name: no floating support on other posts (a warning, which blocks posting), `rigidTapping=false`, negative feed or rpm, non-integral rpm, unrepresentable pitch or feed, G206 dwell over 0.5 s, G207 dwell, feed over machine max, chain-bottom mismatch, and arc/probe/tilt/comp stay refused.
- Fallback is conservative: BORE/BACKBORE and PECK/DEEP with R != entry keep the established expanded chain rather than guessing.
- Goldens: the four Heidenhain goldens changed (`drill_peck`, `drill_plate`, `synth_heidenhain`, `arc_planes`). The drill goldens differ only in the replaced axial chain, now a G200/G205 definition plus an M99 call. `arc_planes` and the `synth` golden differ by the new `G247` preset line (renumbered N words), and the synth golden also by its holes. No other dialect's golden moved. No snapshot PNGs, no process files, no dependency, `build.rs`, scripts or `.github` changes, no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added in non-test code.
- Body has `Changelog:`, `Effort:` and `Fixes #51`; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit; decision file present.

**Local results** (trial-merged with `upstream/main`: clean, no conflicts; macOS, debug)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| app `heidenhain_cycles` / `tapping_mode` / `heidenhain_block_form` / `heidenhain_arc_centre` | 11 / 4 / 5 / 2 passed |
| app `conformance` / `golden_cl` / `posting` / `project_roundtrip` | 6 / 24 / 17 / 71 passed |
| app `fanuc_post` / `arc_planes` / `tap_sim` / `scripting` / `drilling_axial` / `drill_prior_kinds` / `mcp` | 11 / 8 / 2 / 18 / 7 / 4 / 13 passed |
| app `--lib` | 107 passed |
| `camcraft-post` (lib + tests) | all passed (7 / 3 / 9 / 3) |
| `camcraft-cl --lib` / `camcraft-motion --lib drilling::` | 33 / 34 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 454 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy` cl, motion, post, app, ui `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

`cargo xtask gate quick --dry-run` selects the full batch here because `cl`/`motion` changed; I ran the targeted suites above instead, including the ones the quick tier does not map from `assets/posts/*.cps`.

**Requested before merge**
None blocking.

**Questions / notes (not blocking; for the maintainer)**
1. Nobody has run this output on a real TNC or a simulator (the PR says so too). The Q inventories match the documented cycle definitions as I read them, but I could not check the manual PDF itself. Please treat the first real-machine cut as an air cut with single-block.
2. G205 uses `Q202 = Q205 = Q257 = peck` with `Q256 = min(1, peck)`. The old expanded chain retracted 1 mm after each peck (chip-break). With Q257 equal to Q202 the control may instead retract fully after each peck. That is safe but a different motion; `heidenhain.cps` (G205 words) and the decision file claim only "constant chip-breaking", which is worth confirming on a controller.
3. Explicit `G54..G59` now maps to `G247 Q339=1..6` (the previous behaviour was a refusal for G55+ and no word for G54). This is a house mapping, not a TNC convention. A real program with an explicit G54 on a machine whose preset row 1 is not the intended datum now activates row 1 and resets transformations, so the maintainer should confirm the mapping is wanted. An unstated work offset is unchanged.
4. Because PECK/DEEP with R above entry still post as the expanded chain, G205 fires only when R == entry. The generated PECK holes in the field may rarely hit the native path; this is by design but worth knowing.
5. `heidenhain_cycles.rs` is 425 lines and `cnc.rs` (already over 400) grows slightly; flagged only per the 400-line law. `heidenhain.cps` is exempt. There are stray blank lines before `Bore` in the new enum variants (`entity.rs`, `params.rs`, `cycle.rs`, `hole.rs`); cosmetic.
6. UI label text changed from "Tap" to "Tap (rigid)" in the combo; structural UI tests pass.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
